description: Semantic mapping for the 6 Gemini for Government skills across Oracle EBS Receivables (AR), FND Attachments, HR (PER), Purchasing (PO), Trading Community Architecture (TCA / HZ), Sourcing (PON), Internet Expenses (OIE), Payables (AP), and Grants Accounting (GMS).

tables.business_name: Constituent & Public Notices (Skill 3.1: Plain Language Notice Generator)
tables.description: Consolidated view over RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL and FND_DOCUMENTS_LONG_TEXT containing population-level public benefit notices (e.g. NOTICE-CO-SNAP-2026-COLA, NOTICE-MUN-2026-WATER) and individual adverse-action determinations (e.g. CLAIM-84920).

columns.name: NOTICE_ID
columns.description: Notice or determination number (e.g., NOTICE-CO-SNAP-2026-COLA, NOTICE-MUN-2026-WATER, CLAIM-84920).

columns.name: NOTICE_SCOPE_TYPE
columns.description: GOV_PUBLIC_NOTICE (population-level notice eligible for plain-language rewriting) or INDIVIDUAL_ADVERSE_ACTION (must be escalated due to PII and individual fair hearing rights).

columns.name: NOTICE_SUMMARY
columns.description: Summary description of the notice or determination.

columns.name: STATUTORY_NOTICE_TEXT
columns.description: Full text of the statutory directive or notice from FND_DOCUMENTS_LONG_TEXT.

tables.business_name: FOIA & Public Records Production Package (Skill 3.2: Redaction & FOIA Compliance)
tables.description: Consolidated view over PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PO_HEADERS_ALL, and FND_DOCUMENTS_LONG_TEXT for FOIA requests (e.g., FOIA-2026-0412 / RFP-2024-HEALTH / EMP-FOIA-1042).

columns.name: SOLICITATION_OR_CASE_REF
columns.description: Referenced solicitation or case number (e.g., RFP-2024-HEALTH).

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_NAME
columns.description: Full name of public official (e.g., Vance, Jordan R.).

columns.name: RAW_SSN
columns.description: Unredacted Social Security Number requiring mandatory Exemption 6 / 7(C) redaction.

columns.name: RAW_DOB
columns.description: Unredacted Date of Birth requiring mandatory Exemption 6 / 7(C) redaction.

columns.name: FULL_DOCUMENT_CONTENT
columns.description: Full text of the responsive FOIA record containing public award facts plus sensitive PII, FTI (26 U.S.C. 6103), CJIS, and HIPAA PHI.

tables.business_name: Agency Procurement & Statutory Policy Rules (Skill 3.3: Policy & Statute Assistant)
tables.description: Consolidated view over PO_CONTROL_GROUPS_ALL, PO_CONTROL_RULES, and FND_DOCUMENTS_LONG_TEXT covering state procurement thresholds, SNAP separate household & BBCE rules, and post-OBBBA (Pub. L. 119-21) statutory preemption.

columns.name: STATUTORY_POLICY_TEXT
columns.description: Full text of the agency statutory and regulatory policy transmittal.

tables.business_name: Citizen Document Intake Queue & TCA Identity Verification (Skill 3.4: Document Intake Cleanup & Validation)
tables.description: Consolidated view over HZ_PARTIES and FND_DOCUMENTS_LONG_TEXT providing staged citizen intake packets, Gate A optical telemetry, per-field OCR confidence scores, and Gate C paystub math.

columns.name: APPLICANT_LEGAL_NAME
columns.description: Verified legal name in HZ_PARTIES (e.g., Maria Elena Rodriguez, Marcus Vance).

columns.name: INTAKE_OCR_AND_TELEMETRY_PAYLOAD
columns.description: Full Gate A optical metrics, per-field OCR confidence scores, and Gate C paystub gross/net/YTD figures.

tables.business_name: Sourcing Solicitations & Vendor Bids (Skill 3.5: RFP Vendor Evaluation Scorer)
tables.description: Consolidated view over PON_AUCTION_HEADERS_ALL, PON_BID_HEADERS, and FND_DOCUMENTS_LONG_TEXT for RFP-2026-CLOUD-MOD and vendor bids (CivicCloud, LegacyGov, MetroTech).

columns.name: TOTAL_BID_PRICE_USD
columns.description: Total Volume II Cost Proposal amount in USD.

columns.name: RFP_AND_BIDS_EVIDENCE_DOSSIER
columns.description: Complete solicitation Section M.1/M.2 criteria, Addenda 1 & 2, and vendor proposal evidence with page citations.

tables.business_name: Travel Expense Reports & Hotel Folios (Skill 3.6: Expense Auditor)
tables.description: Consolidated view over AP_EXPENSE_REPORT_HEADERS_ALL, AP_EXPENSE_REPORT_LINES_ALL, and FND_DOCUMENTS_LONG_TEXT for 2 CFR Part 200 travel expense audits (e.g., EXP-ATL-9921, EXP-DEN-5521, EXP-CHI-8812).

columns.name: REPORT_SUMMARY_AND_AWARD
columns.description: Claimant, federal grant award ID, and trip purpose.

columns.name: LINE_CLAIMED_AMOUNT_USD
columns.description: Claimed dollar amount for the line.

columns.name: ATTACHED_FOLIO_OCR_TRANSCRIPT
columns.description: Full itemized hotel/flight receipt OCR folio.

tables.business_name: Grant AP Invoices, POs & GMS Awards (Skill 3.6: Expense Auditor)
tables.description: Consolidated view over AP_INVOICES_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, and GMS_AWARDS_ALL for auditing grant invoices and sole-source POs (HM-4409, V-2026-301, MS-1049 / PO-7801).

example_queries.description: Retrieve public notice details for NOTICE-CO-SNAP-2026-COLA
example_queries.sql: SELECT NOTICE_ID, NOTICE_SCOPE_TYPE, STATUTORY_CITATION, STATUTORY_NOTICE_TEXT FROM APPS.VW_GOV_CONSTITUENT_NOTICES WHERE NOTICE_ID = 'NOTICE-CO-SNAP-2026-COLA'

example_queries.description: Retrieve FOIA records and employee personnel file for RFP-2024-HEALTH
example_queries.sql: SELECT FOIA_REQUEST_ID, SOLICITATION_OR_CASE_REF, EMPLOYEE_NUMBER, EMPLOYEE_NAME, FULL_DOCUMENT_CONTENT FROM APPS.VW_GOV_FOIA_RECORDS
